headline: Navi Pillay Wins Nobel Prize
event: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize.
context: Pillay previously served as the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights and has spent decades working in international law.
scope: The global human rights advocacy community and international legal institutions are directly recognized by this award.

headline: Magnitude 7.7 Earthquake Hits Panama
event: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck Panama, causing structural damage and prompting tsunami warnings for neighboring countries.
context: The region lies along active tectonic plate boundaries, making it highly susceptible to seismic activity.
scope: Residents of Panama and coastal populations in neighboring Central American countries are directly affected by the physical damage and emergency alerts.

headline: US Imposes Sanctions On ICC
event: The United States government has announced sanctions against the International Criminal Court.
context: The court has pursued investigations that involve US personnel and allies, drawing opposition from Washington.
scope: International jurists, member states of the tribunal, and global diplomatic relations are directly impacted by this regulatory action.

headline: South Korea Tests Hypersonic Weapon
event: South Korea conducted the first test flight of its domestically developed hypersonic weapon.
context: The test follows a recent hypersonic missile test by North Korea amidst rising border tensions.
scope: The military forces and civilian populations of the Korean Peninsula are directly affected by this shift in regional security dynamics.

headline: US Charges Maduro With Torture
event: United States prosecutors filed new torture charges against the former president of Venezuela, Nicolás Maduro.
context: Maduro was previously ousted from power and already faces multiple US federal indictments related to narcotics trafficking.
scope: The political leadership of Venezuela and US-Venezuelan bilateral relations are directly impacted by this legal action.
